papers.abstract: Planning with world models enables test-time adaptation for embodied agents, offering superior generalization over direct policy learning. However, long-horizon tasks remain hindered by cumulative errors and search complexity. Existing hierarchical methods often use rigid macro-actions or latent skills, leading to brittle representations and limited fine-grained control. We introduce ID-WM (Implicit Dynamics World Models), a hierarchical world model that decouples state-space reachability from local control. Our framework utilizes a high-level model to sample feasible transitions across the state manifold and a low-level world model as an inverse dynamics solver to ground these transitions into precise actions. This allows the planner to identify reachable subgoals without being constrained by low-level execution details. By prioritizing local physical feasibility over global behavioral patterns, ID-WM synthesizes novel long-horizon plans from short segments, transcending the specific behavioral modes seen during training. We demonstrate its effectiveness across three navigation and manipulation suites, achieving a 38.5% improvement over state-of-the-art policy and diffusion-based planners. Crucially, by leveraging this hierarchical structure to mitigate compounding errors, our approach yields a 135% performance gain over single-level world model MPC, particularly in complex, unseen configurations for long-horizon tasks. Videos can be viewed at https://id-wm.github.io

analysis.key_results: 在三个导航和操作套件中，较最先进的策略与扩散规划器提升38.5%；通过分层结构缓解累积误差，相比单层世界模型MPC在复杂未见配置的长时程任务上实现135%的性能增益。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ID-WM（隐式动态世界模型），通过分层结构将高层可达性采样与低层逆动力学求解分离，克服长时程任务中的累积误差与搜索复杂度。
analysis.method: 高层模型采样状态流形上的可行转移，低层世界模型作为逆动力学求解器将转移落到精确动作，规划器据此确定可达子目标。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出ID-WM分层世界模型，将状态空间可达性与局部控制解耦，实现长时程规划并大幅提升机器人导航与操作性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于世界模型驱动的机器人规划，利用隐式动态构建分层世界模型，直接解决物理可行性优先的长时程规划问题，与VLA/WAM所关注的世界建模及真实机器人动作预测高度相关。

papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) learn latent variables from observations and use these to both predict the evolution of the scene and to generate actions. The prediction has to be of the whole scene, whereas only a portion of the scene causes actions. WAMs fitted to demonstrations do not, in general, guarantee that they will generate actions solely from the latent causes of the demonstrated actions (the action-relevant latent variables), as the model could just as well learn to imitate in this way whilst entangling the action-relevant latent variables with the nuisance variables. We therefore separate out what causes action from what prediction depends on. We prove that under a sparsity constraint the latent variables used to generate actions are an invertible function of the action-relevant latent variables alone and the true structure is identified up to a permutation of the latent variables. This requires neither sufficient temporal dependence nor any assumptions on how the unobserved regimes evolve and holds even when the action-relevant latent variables are statistically dependent on the rest. We therefore propose CWAM (Causal WAM), which incorporates the constraint into a pretrained WAM by adding a sparse routing path to its action head, with the world modeling objective remaining unchanged. Experiments on both synthetic data and real-world robots validate the theory as well as showcase the improved efficiency in closed-loop success.

analysis.key_results: 合成数据和真实机器人实验验证了理论，并展示了闭环成功率的效率提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 在稀疏性约束下证明用于生成动作的潜变量是动作相关潜变量的可逆函数，并提出CWAM将约束整合到预训练WAM中。
analysis.method: 在预训练WAM的动作头添加稀疏路由路径，保持世界建模目标不变。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出CausalWAM，通过稀疏路由路径分离动作相关潜变量，使WAM仅从引发动作的原因生成动作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对世界动作模型（WAM），从因果角度改进动作生成，对基于WAM的机器人策略学习具有核心相关性。

papers.abstract: Embodied surgical AI requires reliable multimodal data, yet surgical data collection remains costly, difficult to repeat, and strongly dependent on the hardware setup. We present Sensorium, an open-source Python library for recording, processing, annotating, and curating multimodal surgical data from configurable robot and sensor streams using the Robot Operating System (ROS) and ROS2 middleware. The library combines operator-facing data acquisition, configurable processing, semantic annotation, and episodic dataset generation. We evaluate Sensorium across 1516 recordings of phantom, ex vivo, and in vivo porcine experiments involving multiple surgical tasks and sensing configurations, and report preliminary usability feedback.

analysis.key_results: 在1516次记录中评估了Sensorium，包括幻影、离体和活体猪实验，涉及多种手术任务和传感配置，并报告了初步的可用性反馈。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了Sensorium，一个用于多模态手术数据采集、处理、标注和整理的开源库。
analysis.method: 利用ROS和ROS2中间件，将操作员数据采集、可配置处理、语义标注和情景数据集生成结合起来。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Sensorium是一个基于ROS/ROS2的开源Python库，用于记录、处理、标注和整理多模态手术机器人数据，并支持生成情景数据集。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 无直接关系，但作为手术机器人多模态数据采集与整理工具，可为VLA/WAM相关研究提供数据基础。

papers.abstract: Scaling humanoid motion foundation models is constrained by the scarcity of diverse, robot-executable data and by the difficulty of jointly learning from heterogeneous multimodal inputs while supporting real-time closed-loop control. We present Movens-5M, constructed from raw Internet videos through clip generation, quality filtering, semantic annotation, motion recovery, and physical refinement with humanoid retargeting and execution verification. It contains 15 million human-motion sequences and 5 million physically executable humanoid-motion sequences spanning over 10,000 hours, aligned with text, RGB video, speech, and music. Building on this data, we introduce Movens-Zero, a scalable understanding-generation-execution architecture that supports joint learning across modalities and real-time closed-loop execution. Task-mixed flow-matching training jointly optimizes a single action expert across seven generation tasks, enabling direct motion generation from text, speech, music, and video. Multimodal Real-Time Chunking connects overlapping chunks under continuously updated instructions and robot states for continuous closed-loop execution. We further introduce Movens-Intent, a four-track benchmark with 8,192 expert-verified condition-motion pairs across text, speech, music, and video. Experiments show consistent gains across all four modalities when scaling execution-verified data from 1% to 100% and action-expert capacity from 64M to 911M parameters, while demonstrating that data quality and cross-modal supervision improve generation and execution.

analysis.key_results: 在四个模态（文本、语音、音乐、视频）上的一致性能提升；将执行验证数据从1%扩展到100%，动作专家容量从64M扩展到911M参数，生成和执行效果均得到改善。
analysis.main_contribution: 构建了包含1500万人类运动序列和500万物理可执行人形运动序列的大规模数据集Movens-5M，并提出了Movens-Zero架构，实现从文本、语音、音乐和视频直接生成可执行人形运动，并支持实时闭环控制。
analysis.method: 从互联网原始视频中提取数据，通过剪辑生成、质量过滤、语义标注、运动恢复、人形重定向和执行验证构建数据集；采用任务混合流匹配训练一个多任务动作专家；通过多模态实时分块连接实现连续闭环执行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 构建大规模可执行人形运动数据集Movens-5M，并在此基础上提出支持多模态理解和实时闭环控制的人形运动基础模型Movens-Zero。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于人形机器人的运动生成与执行，构建可执行的运动数据并将语言、视觉等多模态信号与世界运动生成模型结合，属于机器人世界建模范畴，对VLA和世界模型研究具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Simulation benchmarks score robot policies by success rate, and every failed episode counts against the policy. Many of these failures are the simulator's fault, not the policy's; we find the cause and fix it. Testing a vision language action model and a world action model in simulation, we find that the policy often places the object and the simulator then ejects it, and that the benchmark's own scripted demonstrations fail the same way. We present SimuGuard, an auditing plugin for LIBERO, RoboTwin, RoboCasa and RoboDojo. It leaves the evaluation unchanged. At every physics step, it records the state and flags an object that starts moving at a contact faster than the robot's contact or gravity account for. It replays a recorded episode bit for bit, and it reruns the episode with one simulation parameter changed. With it we trace these episodes on RoboTwin to the collision detection of the physics engine: for geometry one to two centimeters apart, the engine reports a penetration of about two centimeters, and the solver throws the object out at several meters per second. The cause is one constant: the distance algorithm discards triangles below a fixed area threshold, which valid triangles fall below at the centimeter scale. With that constant changed and nothing else, episodes with an artifact fall from 12 in 100 to none, and the success rate on five container tasks rises from 89% to 98%. Success rates in simulation thus count failures that the simulator causes. Benchmarks on PhysX 5.3.1 or earlier should rerun in a repaired engine. Where the engine cannot change, they should report the success rate together with the range it spans when every flagged episode fails or passes: 75.8% to 98.5% around a reported 83.1% for LingBot-VA.

analysis.key_results: 修复物理引擎常数后，伪影事件从12%降至0，五个容器任务的成功率从89%提升至98%；LingBot-VA报告的成功率83.1%对应实际范围75.8%至98.5%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SimuGuard，一个用于LIBERO、RoboTwin、RoboCasa和RoboDojo的审计插件，能够在不改变评估的情况下检测并追踪接触伪影。
analysis.method: 在每个物理步骤记录状态并标记物体异常运动，重放记录的事件，并通过改变模拟参数重新运行事件，以定位物理引擎中的碰撞检测缺陷。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文识别并修复了模拟基准中由物理引擎接触检测导致的失败伪影，证明此类伪影人为降低了策略成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接评估了VLA（视觉-语言-动作）和WAM（世界-动作模型）在模拟基准中的表现，发现模拟器物理伪影导致失败，从而影响策略评估的准确性。

figures.caption: A contact artifact turns a correct placement into a failure. After LingBot-VA places the 10 g can in the basket on Place Can Basket (a, b), the can’s speed rises from 0.2 to 22 m/s within one 4 ms physics step, a gain of 2.4 J of kinetic energy, while no robot link touches it and the fastest link moves at under 0.1 m/s (c); the can is ejected from the basket and the benchmark records a failure (d). The time axis has four linear segments, one under each frame.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: SimuGuard audits a simulated evaluation without changing it. Attached by an adapter to the benchmark’s own evaluation script, SimuGuard records every physics step, detects contact artifacts, replays the episode exactly, reruns it with the same actions and one change, and scores the rerun with the benchmark’s own success check. Rerun: a heavier object or more solver iterations leave the artifact; the triangle threshold of PhysX 5.4.0 removes it. Inset: the two pieces that start the ejection of Figure 1 are 21 mm apart, and PhysX 5.3.1 reports them 27.5 mm deep; with the threshold of 5.4.0 it reports no contact. papers.title: When the Simulator Fails, Not the Policy: Auditing Contact Artifacts in Simulated Robot Benchmarks

papers.abstract: Inserting an unseen part requires sub-millimetre precision and the correct orientation of keyed features. Current zero-shot agentic manipulation methods built on vision-language models (VLMs) produce spatial outputs that are far too coarse for this. We propose to let a VLM build a sketch model of the task, i.e., a few geometric primitives and two mate frames, which a VLM agent measures with geometric tools in multi-view depth and which a standard planner and compliant controller execute. Because a sketch describes the parts independently of their placement, the robot needs to build it only once per task. A sketch memory stores each agent run and transfers the stored sketch to later placements by point-cloud registration, so that the VLM is called only for unfamiliar parts. After grasping the part, the robot inspects both mating faces at close range and corrects the sketch by shape matching. On 69 simulated insertion episodes, our method inserts 88% of the parts at the assembled pose in a strict kinematic test, while ReKep and MOKA with the same VLM insert none. On new placements of eight tasks, reusing one stored run inserts as many parts as calling the agent in each episode, and it produces the sketch in 3.4 s instead of about 90 s.

analysis.key_results: 在 69 次仿真插入实验中，严格运动学测试下装配位姿插入成功率为 88%，而同样 VLM 下的 ReKep 和 MOKA 均失败；在 8 个任务的新放置上，重用一次存储运行可插入与每轮调用 VLM 相同数量的零件，草图生成时间从约 90 秒减少到 3.4 秒。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 SketchMate 方法，利用 VLM 构建任务的草图模型（几何基元和配合坐标系），结合多视角深度测量、标准规划器和柔顺控制器，实现零样本精密插入。
analysis.method: VLM 构建草图模型，VLM 智能体在多视角深度中测量，标准规划器和柔顺控制器执行；草图模型与零件放置无关，可存储和通过点云配准迁移到新放置，仅对未知零件调用 VLM；抓取后近距离检测配合面并修正草图。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SketchMate 利用视觉语言模型为精密插入任务构建几何草图模型，实现零样本高精度操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作使用 VLM 构建任务级几何草图，并用于机器人精密操作，属于 VLA（视觉-语言-动作）在机器人操作中的应用，与本站 VLA 主题高度相关，但不涉及世界模型。

ReKep ( Huang et al., 2024b ) lets the VLM write constraints between image keypoints, and MOKA ( Fang et al., 2024 ) lets it select marks and tiles. Our agent builds a metric sketch with geometric tools (orange: moving part, blue: fixed part, symbols as in Section 3.2 ). This sketch identifies the correct opening but misjudges the rotation of the plug by 90 ° 90\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolDegree} (purple, dashed). Once the plug is grasped, matching close-up views of both mating faces recovers the correct rotation (green).
figures.label: Figure 1

The agent (purple) calls geometric tools on three RGB-D views, whereas the memory registers a stored run to the new scene by geometry alone (green). After the grasp, we match the mating end (dark orange) to the height map of the fixed part and insert the part with compliance. The panels show one episode with GPT-6.1-Sol and the NEMA 5-15 task of Section 4.5 , with symbols as in Section 3.2 .

papers.title: SketchMate: Agentic Geometric Reasoning for Zero-Shot Precision Insertion
papers.title_zh: SketchMate：面向零样本精密插入的智能体几何推理

papers.abstract: Vector Quantization (VQ) is a rapidly evolving technique for compressing Large Language Model (LLM) weights, reducing memory usage, and speeding up inference. However, extreme compression deteriorates model performance, which is challenging to recover due to the discrete nature of VQ parameters. Existing methods employ training-free approaches that are limited to layer-wise reconstruction loss minimization. To address this limitation, we propose TVQ, a novel method that leverages straight-through estimation to enable gradient descent-based optimization of vector-quantized LLMs. By reformulating VQ LLM optimization with trainable latent weights, TVQ enables arbitrary objective minimization. We constitute our approach by applying TVQ in a block-wise knowledge distillation paradigm, which balances quality and training efficiency, and propose several practical solutions to accelerate training. In experiments on modern LLMs, we demonstrate that TVQ is compatible with modern VQ schemes. As a result, TVQ achieves state-of-the-art quality in low-bit post-training quantization settings with a modest training budget and straightforward PyTorch implementation. For instance, TVQ achieves near-lossless 2-bit quantization for LLaMA2-70B with only 1% accuracy drop on popular Question-Answering benchmarks.

analysis.key_results: TVQ在低比特后训练量化设置中达到最先进质量，如对LLaMA2-70B实现近无损2比特量化，在问答基准上准确率仅下降1%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TVQ，一种利用直通估计器使向量量化LLM可端到端训练的方法，结合块级知识蒸馏实现高质量低位量化。
analysis.method: 使用直通估计器重构VQ优化，引入可训练潜在权重，并与块级知识蒸馏结合。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出了TVQ方法，通过直通估计器实现向量量化LLM的可训练优化，并在低位后训练量化中取得最先进性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文专注于LLM权重量化，与VLA或WAM无直接关系，但其量化方法可能为机器人视觉语言模型的高效推理提供借鉴。

papers.title: Trainable Vector Quantization for Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: 面向大语言模型的可训练向量量化

papers.abstract:
Robot policy learning is dominated by zeroth-order methods such as PPO, which treat the simulator as a black box and pay for it with enormous sample counts. First-order policy learning differentiates through the dynamics, but on contact-rich whole-body control it has rarely worked: its gradients explode. A recent world-model method showed that derivative information can make humanoid motion tracking far more efficient, using surrogate gradients of a learned model. We show that exact gradients of the simulator itself do better, once two obstacles are removed. Exact gradients contain rare unbounded samples, because contact dynamics is not differentiable everywhere and its derivative diverges near some events; and they are expensive, because the simulator's adjoint has to replay the contact solve. $
abla$Mimic bounds these samples with median-relative per-sample gradient clipping at every step of the backward pass, and reuses each costly simulated window by multistep regression onto gradient-derived action targets, which bounds every action target independently of the gradient scale. NablaEngine, a differentiable GPU simulation engine for the Unitree G1, removes the cost: it computes MuJoCo's full contact dynamics with fused per-world kernels and the adjoint of a whole control step as a single megakernel, with analytic gradients that match float64 finite differences, $11.5	imes$ faster than the available MuJoCo Warp adjoint. On whole-body tracking of all 40 LAFAN1 clips with one policy on one GPU, $
abla$Mimic reaches the score reported by the state-of-the-art world-model method, 0.82, in 20 minutes instead of 1.2 h, and 0.874 in 1.8 h. SHAC, the standard first-order baseline, stops on exploding gradients within minutes. We release NablaEngine and $
abla$Mimic as open-source infrastructure for first-order humanoid policy learning.

analysis.key_results: 在单个GPU上对全部40个LAFAN1片段的全身运动跟踪中，∇Mimic在20分钟内达到世界模型方法报告的0.82分（后者需1.2小时），并在1.8小时内达到0.874分；标准一阶基线SHAC在几分钟内因梯度爆炸停止；NablaEngine的分析梯度与float64有限差分匹配，且比现有MuJoCo Warp伴随实现快11.5倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 去除可微仿真中精确梯度的两个障碍（罕见无界样本与高计算成本），提出∇Mimic方法和NablaEngine可微GPU仿真引擎，实现了比先前世界模型方法更快的人形机器人运动跟踪学习。
analysis.method: 在反向传播的每一步使用中位数相对逐样本梯度裁剪来约束无界样本，并通过多步回归到梯度导出的动作目标来重用每个高成本仿真窗口；同时开发了NablaEngine，一个针对Unitree G1的可微GPU仿真引擎，将MuJoCo完整接触动力学与整个控制步的伴随计算融合为单个megakernel。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出∇Mimic方法，通过使用可微仿真引擎NablaEngine的精确梯度与多步回归动作目标，大幅提升了人形机器人全身运动跟踪的策略学习效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于人形机器人全身运动跟踪的高效策略学习，通过可微仿真和精确梯度优化实现，属于机器人动作与世界模型交叉领域。其方法虽未直接涉及视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA），但NablaEngine作为可微仿真基础设施，可为后续VLA或世界模型的高效训练与验证提供支持。

papers.abstract: Diffusion and flow matching visuomotor policies require iterative denoising or numerical integration for multimodal action generation, introducing latency and execution mismatch. We instead consider a different formulation: conditioned on vision and proprioception, demonstrated bimanual action chunks concentrate in a structured observation-dependent region of joint-action space, making the action target more direct to model than the generative process. Based on this view, we propose the Direct Manifold Action Transformer (DMAT), which reformulates action generation as the direct modeling of clean, observation-conditioned joint-space action chunks from stochastic interpolants, thereby enabling single-step inference without relying on iterative generative inference or auxiliary trajectory-straightening procedures. Within DMAT, local 3D geometry anchors predictions to spatial structure, while State-Consistent Spectral-Time Refinement (STR) reconciles predicted chunks with proprioception and suppresses high-frequency residuals. Across 567 standard and out-of-distribution (OOD) trials per method, DMAT outperformed Improved 3D Diffusion Policy (IDP3) and DiTFlow3D in aggregate success rate, achieving relative improvements of 129.1% and 95.7%, respectively, while generating action chunks 2.06x and 1.34x faster and remaining robust under repeated 50 N interventions. These results pave the way for a novel generative paradigm for efficient and robust bimanual manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在567次标准与分布外试验中，DMAT 的总成功率相对 Improved 3D Diffusion Policy (IDP3) 和 DiTFlow3D 分别提升129.1%和95.7%，动作块生成速度分别快2.06倍和1.34倍，且在重复50 N干预下保持稳健。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Direct Manifold Action Transformer (DMAT)，将动作生成重构为对观测条件下关节空间动作块的直接建模，实现单步推理，无需迭代生成或轨迹矫正。
analysis.method: DMAT 使用随机插值直接建模干净动作块，利用局部3D几何锚定空间结构，并通过 State-Consistent Spectral-Time Refinement (STR) 调和预测动作块与本体感觉、抑制高频残差。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出直接建模干净的动作块而非扩散生成过程，实现单手推理的高效双手操作策略。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略方向，聚焦机器人操作中的高效动作生成，通过直接建模动作流形实现单步推理，替代扩散/流匹配的迭代推理，与本站关注的高效推理和机器人策略直接相关。

papers.abstract: We present TADP, a temporally adaptive differential privacy (DP) framework for inference-time privacy-preserving video generation under fixed-length clip-replacement adjacency. TADP uses a dual-branch design to extract identity and expression representations, clips and privatizes both branches with temporally adaptive Gaussian mechanisms whose noise scales depend only on preceding privatized releases within the same clip and are bounded below by history-uniform calibrated minima, and accounts for their joint release via adaptive R\'{e}nyi Differential Privacy (RDP) composition. The clip-level RDP guarantee is converted to $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-differential privacy, while soft quantization and subsequent temporal processing are applied only after privatization as DP post-processing. Experiments on facial expression datasets show reduced identity leakage under evaluated attacks, usable perceptual quality and temporal stability, and high facial expression recognition utility relative to the evaluated privacy-preserving baselines. TADP formally satisfies clip-level DP and empirically provides a favorable privacy--utility trade-off under the evaluated threat models and datasets.

analysis.key_results: 在面部表情数据集上，与所评估的隐私保护基线相比，降低了身份泄露，保持了可用的感知质量和时间稳定性，并取得了较高的表情识别效用。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TADP框架，通过双分支提取身份和表情表示并进行时间自适应高斯机制加噪，实现推理时视频生成的差分隐私保护。
analysis.method: 采用双分支表示提取、时间自适应高斯机制、自适应Rényi差分隐私组合，以及仅在加噪后进行的软量化与时间处理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种双重分支、时间自适应差分隐私框架TADP，用于视频生成中的隐私保护，并通过实验展示其在隐私-效用上的有利权衡。

papers.abstract: Agentic robots must turn a high-level goal into actions while keeping the physical conditions needed for future steps valid. A completed action does not ensure that its effects will persist: a later disturbance can invalidate support that the remaining plan still assumes. We present LOGIV, a graph engineering framework for agentic robot execution that uses an explicit task graph to connect symbolic planning, observation-based verification, and embodied action. LOGIV compiles a validated plan into condition-support and resource-ordering edges, checks their physical validity during execution, and uses dependency tracing to determine what must be restored after a failure. Repair is constrained by retained unfinished actions, and the combined continuation is symbolically validated before execution resumes. The framework operates above existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World Action Model (WAM) policies without adding trainable components. Across 20 dual-arm tasks from RoboTwin V2 and BiCoord with three execution backbones, LOGIV improves mean task success without injected disturbances by 10.67 and 15.33 percentage points, respectively. Under predefined perturbations, it achieves higher task completion and condition restoration than three adapted recovery baselines for every backbone on both benchmarks. On three real-robot tasks, successful trials increase from 12/30 to 17/30. These results support explicit, continuously checked task dependencies as a practical interface for reliable agentic robot execution.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboTwin V2和BiCoord共20个双臂任务上，无扰动时平均成功率分别提升10.67和15.33个百分点；预定义扰动下任务完成和条件恢复优于三个恢复基线；真实机器人三任务成功率从12/30提升至17/30。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LOGIV图工程框架，通过任务图、条件支撑和资源排序边、执行期物理验证和依赖追踪实现故障修复，不需要额外可训练组件，提升VLA/WAM机器人策略的任务成功率。
analysis.method: LOGIV将验证计划编译为条件-支持和资源-排序边，执行时检查物理有效性，失败后利用依赖追踪确定需恢复的内容，约束修复以保留未完成动作，并在恢复执行前进行符号验证。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: LOGIV框架用显式任务图连接符号规划、观察验证与具身动作，在执行中持续检查物理依赖并提供因果局部修复，从而提升VLA/WAM策略的可靠性。

papers.abstract: Adversarial patches can disrupt Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models by manipulating visual observations, leading to failures in robot control. However, it remains poorly understood which internal mechanisms underlie these failures and how targeted interventions can mitigate them. In this work, we mechanistically analyze VLA representations using a sparse autoencoder (SAE) and identify a feature whose activation strongly correlates with the presence of an adversarial patch. Based on this analysis, we suppress the identified feature at inference time only when a linear probe detects an attack. This intervention improves robustness without the cost of fine-tuning the VLA. We evaluate our method against VLA adversarial patch attacks on LIBERO-10. Conditional intervention improves success rate under intermittent attacks, whereas continuously applying the same intervention substantially degrades policy performance. These results show that attack-related internal representations can provide useful targets for VLA adversarial defense and that controlling when to intervene is important for limiting disruption to nominal policy behavior.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO-10上，条件干预在间歇攻击下提高成功率，而持续干预显著降低策略性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种基于机制分析的VLA对抗补丁防御方法，利用稀疏自编码器识别攻击相关特征，并通过条件性干预在不需要微调的情况下提升鲁棒性。
analysis.method: 使用稀疏自编码器分析VLA表征，识别与对抗补丁强相关的特征；推理时当线性探针检测到攻击时抑制该特征。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文通过稀疏自编码器分析VLA的内部表征，识别与对抗补丁相关的特征，并在推理时根据线性探针检测结果条件性抑制该特征，以提升机器人控制鲁棒性。

papers.abstract: Multi-robot trajectory planning is a fundamental problem in multi-robot coordination but remains computationally challenging due to its nonconvex, multimodal, and high-dimensional nature. This work builds upon D4orm, a dynamics-aware diffusion-denoising framework, and develops a family of planning architectures for diverse operational requirements. Unlike conventional numerical optimization methods, D4orm employs sampling-based optimization to generate solution trajectories through massively parallel sampling, leveraging modern computing architectures such as GPUs. Its diffusion-denoising structure iteratively optimizes deformations to candidate control trajectories, providing an efficient and versatile paradigm for generating kinodynamically feasible and conflict-free trajectories. Using D4orm as the building block for advanced planners, we present a decoupled planner for improved scalability, an online receding-horizon planner with feedback control, and a distributed planner for resource-constrained settings. Evaluations with differential-drive and holonomic robots in 2D and 3D environments demonstrate that D4orm-based approaches find high-quality solutions faster and more reliably than other sampling-based optimization methods, such as MPPI, as well as a learned diffusion-model-based method. We further demonstrate zero-shot deployment on ten real quadrotors with obstacles, large-scale deconfliction with 100 simulated robots, and fully onboard distributed `lifelong' operation with six ground robots. Overall, these results establish diffusion denoising as a scalable and reliable framework for multi-robot coordination. Code and video: https://github.com/proroklab/d4orm

analysis.key_results: 在2D和3D环境中与MPPI和基于学习的扩散模型方法相比，更快更可靠地找到高质量解；实现了10个真实四旋翼的零样本部署、100个模拟机器人大规模冲突消解以及6个地面机器人的完全机载分布式终身运行。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出基于扩散去噪的多机器人轨迹规划架构族，包括解耦规划器、在线滚动时域规划器和分布式规划器，以适应不同操作需求。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 基于扩散去噪框架D4orm的多机器人轨迹规划方法，通过大规模并行采样生成无冲突且动力学可行的轨迹。

papers.abstract: Large video diffusion models provide rich spatiotemporal priors for autonomous driving, but existing world-action models often inherit the cost of iterative future-video generation even though deployment only requires an ego trajectory. We ask a more basic question: how much of a video diffusion model must be executed to make a reliable driving decision? Through a controlled study of video denoising timesteps and Diffusion Transformer (DiT) depth, we find that planning performance is largely insensitive to the tested video-noise levels, whereas strong trajectories can already be decoded from intermediate layers. Based on this observation, we introduce Adaptive-WAM, a quality-aware multi-exit planner built on a Wan2.2-5B backbone. Trajectory diffusion heads are attached to selected DiT blocks, and a lightweight trajectory-quality scorer terminates inference once the best trajectory decoded so far satisfies a quality threshold; otherwise, computation continues from the cached hidden state to a deeper exit. The deployed planner therefore avoids the iterative classifier-free denoising loop and VAE decoding required for future-video synthesis, while dynamically allocating backbone depth according to trajectory quality. On NAVSIM, the adaptive single-trajectory planner achieves 90.8 PDMS; a separate fixed-exit variant reaches 92.6 PDMS with 64 proposals. It further obtains 89.9 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, yielding the best reported results among the compared front-view video world-model planners. Without target-domain fine-tuning, Adaptive-WAM transfers to nuScenes with 0.88 m average L2 error and a 0.08\% collision rate. On an A100, adaptive routing improves PDMS from 90.62 to 90.79 while averaging 170 ms end-to-end planning latency, approximately 10\% below the 190 ms fixed block-15 planner and 47\% below the 320 ms fixed full-depth planner. Code will be released.

analysis.key_results: 在NAVSIM上，自适应单轨迹规划器达到90.8 PDMS；固定出口变体使用64个提议可达92.6 PDMS；在NAVSIM v2上获得89.9 EPDMS，为比较的前视视频世界模型规划器中最佳。在nuScenes上零样本迁移达到0.88 m平均L2误差和0.08%碰撞率。A100上自适应路由将PDMS从90.62提升至90.79，端到端平均170 ms，比固定块-15规划器快约10%，比固定全深度规划器快47%。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by having a draft propose tokens that a target verifies in parallel. Frontier models increasingly ship a built-in Multi-Token-Prediction (MTP) draft head, assumed to be cheap beside verification. A shipped full-attention MTP head can become disproportionately expensive beside a hybrid target at long context. The head attends over the full KV cache for each of $\gamma$ draft forwards per decode step, while only 9-25% of target layers retain full attention, so a single draft layer can issue context reads at a rate comparable to the whole target. On hard, low-acceptance workloads, deep native MTP becomes net-negative: slower than no speculation. We apply a StreamingLLM-style window plus attention sink to the draft only (Windowed-MTP); target verification remains full-context, so the target distribution is preserved. The intervention is training-free and drop-in. On three models from two hybrid families (Gated DeltaNet and Mamba2) at 1M context on one GPU in SGLang, it provides an acceptance-free 1.28-1.44x per-decode-step speedup over native MTP. The speedup grows with context; at matched acceptance, TPOT improves by the same factor. The window removes most of the draft's working set, and a compact ring buffer converts that reduction into physical capacity: it reclaims the otherwise dead draft pool, a measured 7.7-11.1% of total KV at 1M, making room for one additional concurrent 1M request in the Qwen-35B batch sweep.

analysis.key_results: 在三个模型（来自两个混合家族：Gated DeltaNet 和 Mamba2）上，在 SGLang 中，在 1M 上下文、一块 GPU 上，与原生 MTP 相比，每解码步骤实现了 1.28-1.44 倍的无接受速度提升。速度随上下文增长；在匹配接受度下，TPOT 以相同因子改善。窗口移除了大部分草稿工作集，紧凑的环形缓冲区将该减少转化为物理容量：回收了原本死亡的草稿池，在 1M 上下文下占总 KV 的 7.7-11.1%，在 Qwen-35B 批处理扫描中为额外的并发 1M 请求腾出空间。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Windowed-MTP，一种无训练、即插即用的方法，通过在草稿头上应用 StreamingLLM 风格的窗口和注意力 sink 来减少长上下文下原生 MTP 的草稿 KV 成本，同时保持目标分布不变。

papers.abstract: Domain models are central to software engineering, as they enable a shared understanding, guide implementation, and support automated analyses and model-driven development. Yet, despite these benefits, practitioners often skip modeling because it is time-consuming and demands scarce expertise. We address this barrier by investigating whether open-weight large language models, adapted via instruction tuning, can generate high-quality BPMN process models directly from natural language descriptions in a cost-effective and privacy-preserving way. We introduce InstruBPM, a reproducible approach that prepares paired text-diagram data and instruction tunes an open source large language model with parameter-efficient fine-tuning and quantization for on-prem deployment. We evaluate the tuned model through complementary perspectives: (i) text/code similarity using BLEU, ROUGE-L, and METEOR, (ii) structural fidelity using Relative Graph Edit Distance, (iii) guidelines conformance using external tool checks, and (iv) a small expert review. Using a curated subset of a multi-domain BPMN dataset, we compare the tuned model with untuned open-weight baselines and strong proprietary models under consistent prompting regimes. Our compact tuned model outperforms all baselines across sequence and structural metrics while requiring substantially fewer resources; guideline analysis and expert feedback further indicate that the generated diagrams largely follow BPMN best practices and are useful starting points that reduce modeling effort. Overall, instruction tuning improves structural accuracy and robustness compared to untuned baselines and reduces reliance on heavy prompt scaffolding. We publicly share the trained models and scripts to support reproducibility and further research.

analysis.key_results: 紧凑的微调模型在序列和结构指标上优于所有基线，同时所需资源大幅减少；生成的图表基本遵循 BPMN 最佳实践，并可作为有用的建模起点。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出并评估了 InstruBPM，一种通过指令微调与量化，在本地部署的开源大语言模型从自然语言生成 BPMN 流程模型的方法。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文关注 BPMN 模型生成中的模型量化与高效推理，与 VLA、WAM 或机器人动作-世界建模无直接关系，但其量化与指令微调方法可为相关领域的模型部署提供参考。
